english.title: Use a goods vehicle on a road without a ministry plate fitted
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a goods vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), which was not equipped with a ministry plate which was required to be fitted, securely fixed, so as to be legible at all times, in a conspicuous and readily accessible

(A)_[position]_
(B)_[position and in the cab of the vehicle]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 70 of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
